title: MT61123: Diffraction Techniques In Materials Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Production and detection of X-rays. Basic crystallography of materials Symmetry Elements, Point Groups, Space Groups. Reciprocal lattice. Analysis of
diffracted beam direction - Bragg approach and Laue approach. Intensities of
diffracted beams: Scattering from single electron, atom, unit cell, small
crystal â the kinametical theory of x-ray diffraction. Single crystal
diffraction methods and their applications. Modern powder diffraction methods.
Indexing of powder diffraction patterns. Precise lattice parameter estimation.
Determination of crystal structures from symmetry and geometry, and Patterson,
direct and Fourier methods. Rietveled method and precise crystal structures.
Qualitative and quantitative phase identification. Preferred orientation. Grain
size and microstrain, Residual stress. Order-disorder transformations.
Diffraction from thin films. Neutron diffraction. Theory of electron
diffraction, geometry of electron diffraction and their applications,
microdiffraction.
